messages:
sre-ana: Observability alert at 10:12 UTC - eu-west1 apiserver p95 jumped and controller-manager logs show leader-election renew failures. Some GPU node onboarding jobs timing out.
infra-jules: quick correlate -> NAT gateway SNAT port usage at 98% for eu-west1 peak. conntrack short-lived entries all over. Looks like image pull / kubelet / healthcheck churn.
eng-matt: apiserver errors: `net/http: request canceled (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)` and controller-manager: `failed to renew lease: i/o timeout`. Kubelets dropping due to TCP RSTs.
sre-ana: can we get a conntrack dump and `ss -nat` from an affected node? I want to see ephemeral port allocation pattern.
infra-jules: pasted results inline: `ss -s` -> "TCP: inuse 9210 orphan 0 tw 2093 alloc 32768"; `conntrack -L | wc -l` -> 42k entries with many ESTABLISHED short timers. NAT gateway shows many SNAT translations to same external port ranges.
eng-matt: hypothesis: massive parallel image pulls and registry calls when GPU DaemonSet scales up cause ephemeral port exhaustion on nodes + NAT. Controller-manager leader renews hit deadlines because requests to API kubelets/probes are delayed.
sre-ana: short-term ops plan: 1) throttle GPU onboarding rollout to 25% at a time 2) increase apiserver keepalive & timeouts to be tolerant of brief network flakiness 3) request NAT pool bump as emergency fallback.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-173 - SNAT port depletion in eu-west1 impacting control-plane leadership. Severity: Sev3.
infra-jules: can push NAT pool +20% immediately but that increases egress cost for the region ~+$1.2k/day at peak. Need go-ahead.
eng-matt: I'll open a low-risk kube-apiserver flag PR: `--http2-max-streams-per-connection` tweak and bump `--keep-alive-interval=60s`. Also adjust controller-manager flags: `--leader-election-renew-deadline=30s` and `--leader-election-retry-period=10s`.
sre-ana: agree with config bumps as temporary mitigation. Also reduce kubelet image pull concurrency via KubeletConfig on the affected node pool (set registry puller parallelism down).
deploy-bot: Scheduled: kube-apiserver canary restart on eu-west1-a at 10:35 UTC.
infra-jules: NAT pool scaled +20% as temporary. Monitoring added for SNAT usage >80% to trigger autoscale.
sre-ana: 12 minutes after mitigations, apiserver p95 down from ~720ms to ~140ms, leader-election errors cleared. GPU onboarding queued but progressing with throttles.
eng-matt: post-incident tasks: implement automatic onboarding backoff when SNAT > 75%, add alert for controller-manager lease renewal failures, and add per-node ephemeral port usage dashboard.
sre-ana: Also add docs for cost tradeoff: quick NAT pool scale vs staggered onboarding. Will write a short postmortem and schedule a follow-up with infra to discuss more durable NAT scaling (e.g., per-subnet NATs, or using direct IPs for registry egress).
infra-jules: noted. I'll propose infra change in next sprint planning. :+1:
